definitions.explanation: An event or act of celebrating something happy.
Words or actions expressing joy at someone's good fortune.
A gift given to celebrate an occasion.

⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝|いわ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{祝|いわ}い is the noun form of ⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧ (to celebrate).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{祝|いわ}い (celebration, gift - polite)
- {祝|いわ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (celebratory gathering)
- お{祝|いわ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧ (to offer congratulations)

TYPES:
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{祝|いわ}い: wedding celebration/gift
- ⟦{出産|しゅっさん}→出産：11734_shussan⟧{祝|いわ}い: baby shower gift
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧{祝|いわ}い: school entrance celebration
- ⟦{還暦|かんれき}→還暦：05807_kanreki⟧{祝|いわ}い: 60th birthday celebration
